data.description: You cause the targets to believe they hear any sound you imagine. The sound can include intelligible speech. Instead of precisely imagining a sound, you can identify a sound the subjects know and they imagine it doing what you describe as you cast the spell. All targets hear the same hallucination. You can change the sound as part of concentrating on the spell.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell

raw_tokens.value: Create a phantasm with auditory effects.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell

You cause the targets to believe they hear any sound you imagine. The sound can include intelligible speech. Instead of precisely imagining a sound, you can identify a sound the subjects know and they imagine it doing what you describe as you cast the spell. All targets hear the same hallucination. You can change the sound as part of concentrating on the spell.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
(CASTERLEVEL) creatures, no two of which can be more than 30ft. apart
